title: Oracle Log Analytics

fields.name: config_file_location
fields.description: The location of the configuration file containing OCI authentication details.

fields.name: profile_name
fields.description: OCI Config Profile Name to be used from the configuration file

fields.name: namespace
fields.description: OCI Tenancy Namespace in which the collected log data is to be uploaded

fields.name: proxy
fields.description: define proxy if required, in [http://host:port](https://docs.fluentbit.io/manual/3.2/pipeline/outputs/http:/host:port) format, supports only http protocol

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of [workers](/manual/3.2/administration/multithreading.md#outputs) to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.

description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Logging Analytics output plugin allows you to ingest your log records into OCI Logging Analytics service.
